findings.quoted_text: 10.2.3 in its entirety or with respect to one or more Products, on a Product-by-Product basis, by SutroVax upon [***] days' prior written notice to Sutro for any reason.
10.2.3 in its entirety or with respect to one or more Products, on a Product-by-Product basis, by [PARTY_B] upon [***] days' prior written notice to Sutro for any reason.
findings.explanation: Only the Client has the right to terminate the agreement without cause. While your incurred costs and work-in-progress are reimbursed upon such termination, it remains one-sided because you lack an equivalent right to walk away without cause.
findings.suggested_change: 10.2.3 in its entirety or with respect to one or more Products, on a Product-by-Product basis, by either Party upon [***] days' prior written notice to the other Party for any reason.
